name: 办公室升降桌
reconstruction: SfM from a 16.5 s phone video and 5 photos (PLAN.md, REPORT.md); build_scene.py, check_scene.py
scale_basis: estimated: three agreeing priors, white desk 1.20 m long, orange desk 0.75 m high, 0.50 m carpet tiles; tabletop 1.186 x 0.590 m, top 0.715 m fitted to the photos through the SfM cameras (fit_table.py, 2026-10-30), so in the SfM scale, not tape-measured

photo_overlay.method: fit_table.py: the table's length, width, top height and pose fitted to its edges in photos p0-p4 through the SfM cameras (reference/cameras_scene.json, not fitted to the table); these views are video frames left out of the fit, so out-of-sample; per frame the largest median offset of its tabletop sides. Frames not framing the table centre do not count (v0040, 8 px: only the shaded left end at the border). Not the robot-camera overlay (overlay)
photo_overlay.before: 1.20 x 0.62 x 0.68 m priors: 10.8-15 px on the same frames

lighting.note: sun direction from the video; brightness not compared with the head camera

photo_match.method: Isaac RTX from each fitted photo camera (scripts/scenes/render_scenes.py --photos), median CIELAB of photo vs render over the whole frame, averaged over the photos; target |dL*| <= 5, |db*| <= 3; phone auto exposure and white balance make it indicative only. The table stands 0.84 m east of where it was photographed (ROOM_SHIFT), so it sits elsewhere in the renders
photo_match.change: sun 3000 -> 450 and warmer (1, 0.88, 0.74); window fills 400 / 250 -> 60 / 37.5, bluish -> warm white; dome kept at 150 (it is the sky in the windows), bluish -> (1, 0.95, 0.88); L* 52.9, b* 0.2 before. G1-D head camera median L* 47.5 -> 31.4 in g1d

notes: The robot stand is chosen for reach (root y = -0.73), not measured; in the source video the robot stood near room y = -0.95. The 2026-09-21 real run had the desk and sofa elsewhere, so its head frames cannot be used for the overlay. The 5 tabletop objects in usd/objects/ are not loaded by real_scene1.usd.
